transcript: Google just made a massive shift, and it's already leaving thousands of small businesses behind. And the craziest part is that most business owners haven't even noticed. Here's what's changed. The way people discover businesses online has shifted again. People aren't scrolling through the search results anymore. Now they're asking AI for answers and getting them instantly. And if your brand and your business isn't showing up in those answers, well, might as well not exist. And that shift has made a lot of the usual marketing tactics just way less effective. For example, having good content alone just isn't enough anymore. And visibility now depends on whether the algorithm sees your business as credible or not.
